description: This Scala source file defines the class PruneHiveTablePartitions, which implements a rule for pruning Hive table partitions based on filters in Spark SQL's logical plan. It updates table statistics and manages partition pruning during query optimization.
external_files: org.apache.spark.sql.catalyst.expressions.{And, AttributeSet, Expression, ExpressionSet, PredicateHelper, PythonUDF, SubqueryExpression}

classes.name: PruneHiveTablePartitions
classes.description: A Spark SQL optimization rule that prunes Hive table partitions based on filter expressions, updating table statistics and managing pruned partitions.

methods.name: getPartitionKeyFilters
methods.description: Extracts partition key filters from a sequence of filter expressions, normalizing and filtering out non-deterministic or subquery-based expressions.

methods.name: updateTableMeta
methods.description: Updates the metadata of a Hive table with statistics based on the pruned partitions and filter conditions.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Applies the partition pruning rule to a logical plan during query optimization, modifying the plan to include pruned partitions and updated statistics.
